title: Chroma Record
description: A Chroma record represents a single item stored in a collection, consisting of an embedding vector, optional document text, optional metadata, and an optional URI reference.

id.description: A unique identifier for the record within the collection. Must be unique across all records in the collection.

embedding.description: The vector embedding for this record. Each element is a floating point number representing a dimension of the embedding space.

document.description: The text document associated with this record. If provided without an embedding, the server will automatically generate an embedding from the document text.

metadata.description: Key-value metadata associated with the record. Values can be strings, numbers, integers, or booleans. Metadata is searchable using where filters.

uri.description: An optional URI reference associated with the record, typically pointing to the source content or an external resource.

Embedding.description: A vector embedding represented as an array of floating point numbers

WhereFilter.description: A metadata filter expression used to narrow search results based on record metadata values. Supports comparison operators ($eq, $ne, $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $in, $nin) and logical operators ($and, $or).

WhereDocumentFilter.description: A document content filter expression used to filter records by their document text. Supports $contains, $not_contains for substring matching and $regex, $not_regex for pattern matching.

IncludeField.description: A field that can be included in query and get responses

QueryResult.description: The result of a vector similarity query, containing matched record IDs and optionally their embeddings, documents, metadatas, distances, and URIs

ids.description: Nested arrays of record IDs, one array per query

embeddings.description: Nested arrays of embedding vectors, one array per query

documents.description: Nested arrays of documents, one array per query

metadatas.description: Nested arrays of metadata objects, one array per query

distances.description: Nested arrays of distance scores, one array per query

uris.description: Nested arrays of URIs, one array per query
